body:
# Description
Wynn Ultimate is a modpack for the Minecraft server Wynncraft. This pack gives you all the tools Wynncraft pros use while still being Vanilla friendly! Whether you're grinding professions, running raids, exploring secret discoveries, or leveling a new class, Ultimate Wynn is built to make every part of the journey feel faster, cleaner, and more enjoyable. Every mod included has been selected to improve gameplay without overwhelming the core Wynncraft experience.

## Performace Improvements
Enjoy smoother gameplay, better FPS, reduced lag, and faster loading times for a more stable experience across every region and activity.

## Better visuals
Subtle visual upgrades and cleaner presentation help modernize the game while keeping the familiar Wynncraft atmosphere intact.

![Sunset over the ocean](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3681d9637d1c1aa55eb70b5dd06cf2fe36feae04.png)

![Render distance with Voxy](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5900ebe9d07ea256b2496317fdb0a148fd0412c3.png)

### Please read
**Do not update the mod Sodium in this modpack as it will cause issues**
